title: When Experts Speak: Sequential LLM-Bayesian Learning for Startup Success Prediction
reasoning: The paper focuses on financial prediction models for startup success using LLMs and Bayesian learning. It evaluates its model against several baselines (benchmarks) such as SVM, LR, and various transformer models. While it mentions policy goals like innovation equity and allocative fairness, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems.
